title: Register as a wholesaler of Scheduled substances
what: Sell Scheduled substances (other than Schedule 5 and 6) by wholesale only under a wholesaler certificate of registration.

laws.title: Medicines, Poisons and Therapeutic Goods Act 2012 (NT)

sources.title: Medicines, Poisons and Therapeutic Goods Act 2012 (NT)
sources.quote: A person commits an offence if the person: (a) sells by wholesale a Scheduled substance, other than a Schedule 5 or 6 substance, from a place; and (b) the sale is not authorised under a wholesaler certificate of registration

sources.title: Medicines, Poisons and Therapeutic Goods Act 2012 (NT)
sources.locator: s 49, words naming the body (found 18 Nov 2026) (current reprint)
sources.quote: CHO may issue a Schedule 8 exemption to an authorised health practitioner for the possession of a restricted Schedule 8 substance for its supply for an authorised purpose.
